description: This file defines API functions for handling authentication-related operations in a React project, such as user registration, login, token refresh, and logout. It also includes utility functions for token extraction and normalization.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from an authentication response, supporting multiple possible response shapes.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token string by removing 'Bearer' prefixes and invalid value handling.

methods.name: safeSetTokens
methods.description: Stores valid access and refresh tokens after normalization, only if at least one token is valid.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant user via POST /auth/register, normalizing email input.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login, clears old tokens, extracts new tokens, and stores them if valid.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens by posting the refresh token and updating stored tokens.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the backend.
